en: A vintage postcard showing a riverside or coastal promenade with people walking and relaxing along the water's edge. Some are wearing late 19th or early 20th-century clothing. There are boats moored by the side, and trees line the walkway. The colors are muted, typical of early colorized postcards. There is text in both Greek and Latin script at the top left, and a website watermark at the bottom right.
